title: Dalton Risner: New Bengals deal wouldn't have gotten done without Joe Burrow

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dalton Risner: New Bengals deal wouldn't have gotten done without Joe Burrow
sources.description: The Bengals got a deal done with right guard Dalton Risner on Monday and Risner credited one of his teammates with helping to pave the way to the agreement.
